idea-plugin.name: Code Marker
idea-plugin.description:
Code Marker puts an icon in the editor gutter next to Java method calls that match rules you define, so the calls that matter in your project, such as database access, remote calls or transactional services, stand out while you read the code.

Features

  • Rules by class, annotation and method: match calls by the class that declares the method, by an annotation on the method or its class, by the method name, or any combination of them.
  • Inheritance aware: super classes, interfaces and overridden methods are checked as well, so a rule on an interface also marks calls through its implementations.
  • Simple or fully qualified names: write Service or org.springframework.stereotype.Service, with or without the leading @.
  • Built-in icon set: pick an icon for each rule from the bundled icons.
  • Documentation on hover: hovering a gutter icon shows the documentation of the called method.
  • Ordered rules: rules are checked from top to bottom and the first match wins. Reorder them by dragging a row or with the toolbar buttons.
  • Import and export: save the rule list to an XML file and share it with your team.

Getting Started

  1. Open Settings | Tools | Code Marker.
  2. Add a rule and fill in a class name, an annotation, or both. The method name is optional; leaving it empty matches every method.
  3. Choose an icon and apply. Open editors are updated right away.
